versions.changelog:
- Now requires that the source link line after the title uses the absolute GitHub URL (`https://github.com/j3ffyang/ai-thoughts/blob/main/docs/<source-filename>`) instead of a relative link.
- Updated the procedure and verification checks to reflect this absolute URL requirement for linking to the original article.
- No other procedure or logic changes. 
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Dropped extra trailing space from the "arch sign-off" detection and output rule for improved accuracy and consistency.
- Removed the obsolete "skill-card.md" documentation file.
- No changes to logic or functionality; only documentation was updated for clarity.

- Added support for carrying over the “arch sign-off” line (`btw, i use arch <glyph>`) at the bottom of translated files, verbatim in English.
- Clarified that image references (`../imgs/<file>`) must be preserved verbatim, as Chinese files mirror English.
- Required bilingual glossing of technical terms inside table cells on first appearance.
- Improved wording to specify the output path convention and to clarify preservation and glossing rules.
- Removed obsolete file (`skill-card.md`).

- Added support for a "bilingual-gloss" style: all Simplified Chinese outputs now include inline English glosses for technical terms and section titles, plus plain-language explanations for unfamiliar concepts.
- Updated procedures and verification steps to require glossing of technical vocabulary and explanatory additions for clarity.
- Removed skill-card.md (no longer used).
- Quality and error handling sections remain unchanged except for references to the new glossing requirements.

- Minor update: documentation cleanup, no functional changes.
- Reformatted SKILL.md for improved readability (compact, consistent Markdown).
- Removed redundant file skill-card.md.

Initial release: skill for translating articles to Simplified Chinese on demand.

- Translates a user-selected article from ai-thoughts/docs/ into Simplified Chinese, outputting an exactly-matching -chn.md file.
- Runs only when a specific article is chosen; never acts automatically or picks files by itself.
- Confirms the source file, output path, and any overwrite actions with the user before proceeding.
- Faithfully translates prose while preserving intact product names, commands, code, technical terms, file names, links, and images.
- Does not modify the original article, articles.yaml, or READMEs; strictly limited to producing the -chn.md file in docs/.
